title: Google Cloud Architecture Framework — Failure Injection & Auto-Healing
purpose: Simulates architectural drift: unauthorized infrastructure change detected by Security Command Center and auto-remediated via Cloud Functions.
routing_rationale: Real-time posture management detects misconfigurations that diverge from approved architectural baselines and triggers instant policy enforcement.

nodes.label: Rogue Firewall Rule
nodes.detail: Developer manually opened public SSH port to debug a production issue.

nodes.label: Security Command Center
nodes.detail: SCC Real-time posture engine flags high-severity vulnerability within 15 seconds.

nodes.label: Security Finding Event
nodes.detail: SCC streams JSON finding event to pubsub topic 'security-auto-heal'.

nodes.label: Auto-Remediation Function
nodes.detail: Invokes Compute Engine API to immediately delete rogue firewall rule.

steps.title: Continuous Posture Detection
steps.action: SCC scans resource changes and identifies open SSH port violating org policy.
steps.why_traversal: Eliminates reliance on periodic manual audits; catches exposures immediately.

steps.title: Event-Driven Orchestration
steps.action: Alert streams through Pub/Sub to trigger serverless remediation handler.
steps.why_traversal: Decouples detection from automated action, enabling auditable remediation.

steps.title: Automated Policy Restoration
steps.action: Cloud Run function deletes rogue rule and alerts SecOps in Slack.
steps.why_traversal: Reduces mean time to remediate (MTTR) from hours to 8 seconds.

scenarios.label: IAM Permission Deprivation on Remediation SA
scenarios.root_cause: Remediation Service Account lacked compute.securityPolicies.delete permission.
scenarios.diverted_path: Remediation function throws HTTP 403 Forbidden; rogue rule remains open.
scenarios.blast_radius: Compute instance exposed to internet scanning for 4 hours.
scenarios.recovery: Grant custom role with exact required permissions and set up failure alert on remediation function errors.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

summary: Simulates architectural drift: unauthorized infrastructure change detected by Security Command Center and auto-remediated via Cloud Functions.
